Cultist.CultistRiteDef.label: Sunset Rite
Cultist.CultistRiteDef.description: The standard starter rite. Combines Lore, an optional Ritual Tool, Influence, and a society Assistant. Consumes Lore and Influence; keeps the Tool and Assistant.

Cultist.CultistRiteDef.label: Rite of the Watchman's Sorrow
Cultist.CultistRiteDef.description: A refined ceremony of Lore, Ritual Tool, and Influence. Lowers backlash risk by 8% and preserves the Tool.

Cultist.CultistRiteDef.label: Rite of the Crucible Soul
Cultist.CultistRiteDef.description: A fierce rite of Lore, Ritual Tool, and Sacrifice. Preserves both Lore and Tool; the sacrificed captive automatically fills the first unmet aspect requirement.

Cultist.CultistRiteDef.label: Rite of the Mother's Mercy
Cultist.CultistRiteDef.description: A four-slot grand summoning combining Lore, Ritual Tool, Influence, and Sacrifice. Preserves Lore and Tool while the sacrifice fills the first unmet aspect.

Cultist.CultistRiteDef.label: Rite of the Beast's Division
Cultist.CultistRiteDef.description: A savage rite requiring no Lore book: combines Ritual Tool, Influence, and Sacrifice. Preserves the Tool while the sacrifice fills the first unmet aspect.

ThingDef.label: rite script: Watchman's Sorrow
ThingDef.description: A recovered ceremonial folio detailing the Rite of the Watchman's Sorrow. Study it to unlock this rite permanently for your society.

ThingDef.label: rite script: Crucible Soul
ThingDef.description: A scorched vellum detailing the Rite of the Crucible Soul. Study it to unlock this sacrifice-enabled rite permanently for your society.

ThingDef.label: rite script: Mother's Mercy
ThingDef.description: An ancient Knock scroll detailing the Rite of the Mother's Mercy. Study it to unlock this four-slot grand rite permanently for your society.

ThingDef.label: rite script: Beast's Division
ThingDef.description: A blood-stained parchment detailing the Rite of the Beast's Division. Study it to unlock this lore-free sacrifice rite permanently for your society.
